secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (browser/public). Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key. Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (server-side). Same Project URL as above.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role secret key. Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → Project API keys → service_role.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
secrets.description: Supabase Postgres connection string (URI). Supabase Dashboard → Settings → Database → Connection string.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for the AI tutor. Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) → API keys.
